description: Mediation Boards Commission - Notice calling for nominations for the appointment of Mediators
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for judicial dispute resolution positions (Chairman and Mediators) under the Mediation Boards Act, establishing eligibility criteria, and outlining the appointment process through the Mediation Boards Commission. This fits Type 9 as it deals with judicial appointments and the administration of alternative dispute resolution mechanisms within the legal system.
